build_local_environment_instance: build a LocalEnvironment instance with a custom working directory, timeout, and environment variables
run_bash_command: run a bash command string in a subprocess with optional login shell and stdin data
sanitize_subprocess_env: sanitize a subprocess environment dictionary by filtering out Hermes provider secrets and API keys
get_temp_dir: get a shell-safe writable temporary directory path for local command execution
kill_process_group: kill a subprocess and its entire process group with SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback
